title: EGAnetLab: A jamovi Module for Exploratory Graph Analysis

creators.name: Chacón Chacón, Arquímedes De León
creators.affiliation: Universidad Católica Andrés Bello (UCAB), Caracas, Venezuela

description: An open-source jamovi module that brings the network psychometrics methods of the EGAnet R package to jamovi (Exploratory Graph Analysis, bootstrap stability, redundancy analysis, entropy fit, confirmatory factor analysis, hierarchical, random-intercept, invariance, centrality and dynamic extensions), pairing every result with evidence-based methodological guidance, interpretation and educational support in English and Spanish.
